Latitude.note:
This places the planned plant on the developer's own site map and checks it against satellite imagery.

Where the site map is:
- Open the Detailed Site Layout Map Book at https://apps.psc.wi.gov/ERF/ERFview/viewdoc.aspx?docid=617761 . It is Appendix A of the application in Wisconsin Public Service Commission docket 5-CE-162, received November 6, 2026. Go to PDF page 2, titled 'Detailed Site Layout Map Book: Proposed Site' for the 'Forest Junction & Union Depot Energy Centers' in Calumet County.
- The page has no text layer, so I read it by eye. The outline marked 'Proposed Site Footprint' in the legend sits just north of County Road K, labeled 'Cth K', and east of Highway 57. Inside it are the plant pads and the site roads.

How the point was found:
- I tied the map to five road points from OpenStreetMap. They are where Holmes Road meets Schmidt Road, where Highway 57 crosses Schmidt Road, where the south part of Holmes Road meets County Road K, and two points on Highway 57 north of the road.
- The map's own scale bar of 600 feet agrees with these points. The fit error is under 1 meter.
- The middle of the outlined footprint is at 44.23038, -88.11715. Pin: https://www.google.com/maps/search/?api=1&query=44.23038,-88.11715 .

What the satellite picture shows:
- A large farm field directly north of County Road K, with a curving drainage swale and a farmstead at its southwest corner. The map book shows the same field and farmstead. Nothing is built yet, which fits a planned plant. The imagery date is unknown.

Other checks:
- The application at https://apps.psc.wi.gov/ERF/ERFview/viewdoc.aspx?docid=617707 says on PDF page 20, section 2.1.1, 'The Proposed Site is located in Section 04, Township 20 North, Range 20 East' in the Town of Brillion. The point is inside that section.
- The first look put the point at 44.22950, -88.11800 from wetland sampling points. The new point is about 120 m from it, so both looks agree.
- The new point is about 7.0 km north and west of the point in the database, 44.18800, -88.05200.
- The map book shows one footprint for both Forest Junction and Union Depot. The two plants share the site, so the same point fits both.
